headline: Get Sparki at Night
title: How to Get Sparki | Only Spawns at Night | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Sparki is a Fire Aniimo, and it only spawns at night. Set the clock with the Day and Night control, which unlocks after some quests. Then head to Nimbus Fields, Beast Fang Ridge or Blitzwood. In Beast Fang Ridge, look near the flaming rock in the middle of the forest. Sparki glows, so you can spot it from far away. At level twenty one it can become Flamerion. Have you caught a Sparki? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Sparki is a Fire Aniimo that spawns only at night in Nimbus Fields, Beast Fang Ridge and Blitzwood. Use the Day and Night control, look near the flaming rock, and evolve it into Flamerion at level 21.
